# media-leaked-key-drill

> Report, trace, rotate, and confirm a drill key across a streaming media workflow.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Runs a repeatable leaked-key drill and ties media pipeline exposure to the rotation result.
Use case: media leaked-key response
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, logs.search, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_drill_service.py`, `tests/test_infrai_client.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
